source.title: Witvliet et al. developmental brain, specimen 1

source.region: head / brain: nerve ring, ventral ganglion and reconstructed anterior neuropil
source.nodeUniversePolicy: Observed endpoints of retained chemical connections only; this is not a complete reconstructed-cell inventory and does not declare unobserved catalog cells as isolates.
source.weightDefinition: Sum of source chemical synapse occurrence counts for each directed pre/post pair. A source annotation ID can contribute to several post-synaptic pairs; summed edge weights are not counts of unique source annotation IDs.
source.limits: Cross-sectional specimens, not longitudinal imaging of one animal. Four L1 specimens, one L2, one L3 and two adults; approximate ages from source metadata. Absent/unobserved cells and edges are not proven biological absence. Chemical contacts include muscles and other non-neuronal cells. Partial gap-junction annotations are excluded. No neural activity, efficacy, causal development or whole-302-neuron coverage is established.

manifest.licenseScope: This notice applies to the selected NemaNode source records and their transformed factual table representation. No upstream application code is copied. It is not a blanket license for other Synapse Atlas assets.
notes: Four L1 specimens (0,5,8,16h), one L2(23h), one L3(27h), two adults(~50h) according to pinned author/lab metadata.
The Zenodo 5637219 CC BY 4.0 license concerns deposited 3D models and is not claimed for these connectivity tables.
Original analysis repository has no root license; chosen raw data representation is the official lab NemaNode repository carrying GPL-3.0.
Node universes contain observed chemical endpoints, including non-neuronal cells. Presence in one graph and absence in another need not mean the cell was born/lost.
Different ages are different individuals. Descriptive differences combine age, individual variation, reconstruction and annotation differences.
